quantisation: Spark: calibrated GPTQ NVFP4 attention, lm_head and L20-23 experts over the shipped checkpoint, for decode and verify rows; prefill reads the checkpoint's own tensors, its experts' inputs quantized as its hf_quant_config.json requires (NVFP4 / MXFP8 rows, W4A4 / W8A8)
drafter: DSpark (bundled mtp.safetensors), greedy drafts: 7 draft tokens with one live request, plain decode from two (ATLAS_DFLASH_BATCH_DEPTH=1:7,1000000:0); verifies stop where the drafter is unsure (ATLAS_DFLASH_CONF_WIDTH=1: the engine learns while serving how often each draft confidence is accepted), drafts go off for a sequence whose steps stop paying, for 32 tokens at first and doubling while re-probes fail (ATLAS_DFLASH_ADAPTIVE=1, threshold 2.5 (ATLAS_DFLASH_ADAPTIVE_MIN=2.5) accepted a block), in place of the engine throughput gate (ATLAS_MTP_GATE_FORCE=1)
scheduler: SparkInkling default profile: max-num-seqs 8, gpu-memory-utilization 0.80, prefill chunks 4096, CUDA graphs, programmatic dependent launch (ATLAS_INKLING2_PDL=1), prefix caching with conv-state snapshots (--enable-prefix-caching, --ssm-cache-slots=128, ATLAS_QWEN4EXP_AUX_PINNED=1) and branch checkpoints (ATLAS_GLM_PC_BRANCH=1, ATLAS_GLM_PC_BRANCH_MIN=512), --request-timeout=3600, --tool-max-tokens=32768
competing_traffic: none (the voice engines suspended through LLooM for the window)
